metadata.description: Nitin's personal Claude Code plugins — reusable skill packs for engineering workflows.

plugins.name: eng
plugins.description: Plan-to-ship engineering pipeline: scope a task into Jira tickets, grill the requirements, review the plan against house conventions, define tests, then implement and verify — all driven off a shared doc in the project's .plan folder.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product-thinking skills: write staff-level PRDs and slice them into testable user stories. Output can feed the eng pipeline.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Workflow helpers: catchup on changes, caveman terse mode, session handoff, and standalone plan grilling.
